summary: SiTime Corp filed a prospectus supplement for an offering of $1.2 billion in 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. The notes carry no regular interest, are convertible into common stock at an initial conversion price of ~$1,040.47 per share, and include early conversion triggers and optional redemption features. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a convertible debt issuance—and does not constitute a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No special-situation event is described.
